mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice (title, content, author, hit, write_date, category) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{author}, 0, now(), #{category, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler})
mapper.select:
SELECT count(*) FROM notice
AND category = #{category, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}
AND title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{word}, '%')
AND author LIKE CONCAT('%', #{word}, '%')
AND (title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{word}, '%') OR author LIKE CONCAT('%', #{word}, '%'))
